audit_title: CYCLONEX Scientific Validation & Feature Lineage Audit

sources.dataset_name: NOAA IBTrACS v04r00 North Indian Ocean Subset

sources.note: Static single tiles; not temporally co-located across all 26 historical IBTrACS track points.

excluded_features.reason: CRITICAL TARGET LEAKAGE. By definition of the WMO/IMD classification standard, IMD tiers 0 through 7 are defined as direct, non-overlapping intervals of sustained wind speed (e.g. Tier 4 is strictly 48-63 kts). Including wind speed allows any decision tree to trivially learn the boundary thresholds.

Raw tabular IBTrACS observations do not contain continuous raster symmetry metrics. Synthetically generating CDO from the target tier (as done in calibration scripts) constitutes circular target leakage.
Raw tabular IBTrACS observations do not contain satellite brightness temperature. Synthetic generation would fabricate data.
In-situ humidity and SST are not recorded in the raw IBTrACS track points and cannot be fabricated without scientific dishonesty.

scientific_benchmark_features.name: pressure_deficit_hpa
scientific_benchmark_features.rationale: Core barometric depression indicates vortex depth independent of direct wind observation.

scientific_benchmark_features.name: central_pressure_hpa
scientific_benchmark_features.rationale: Directly observed central surface pressure from meteorological reports.

scientific_benchmark_features.name: latitude
scientific_benchmark_features.rationale: Coriolis force parameter ($f = 2\Omega \sin\phi$) governs cyclonic vortex spinup potential.

scientific_benchmark_features.name: longitude
scientific_benchmark_features.rationale: Distinguishes Bay of Bengal from Arabian Sea climatological basin dynamics.

scientific_benchmark_features.name: movement_speed_kmh
scientific_benchmark_features.rationale: Translation velocity impacts vortex residence time over oceanic heat content.

scientific_benchmark_features.name: seasonality_sin
scientific_benchmark_features.rationale: Captures North Indian Ocean pre-monsoon (May) vs post-monsoon (Oct-Dec) cyclone peaks.

validation_protocol.description: Each storm (REMAL, BIPARJOY, MICHAUNG, AMPHAN) is held out completely as an out-of-sample test set while the model is trained exclusively on the remaining storms. Zero observations belonging to the held-out cyclone appear in training.
Grouped cross-validation grouped strictly by cyclone ID to prevent time-adjacent row leakage.
